name: aljazmc
description: Lightweight npm packages written in modern TypeScript: a formatter, a linter, a monorepo release tool and a test runner.
author: aljazmc

engines.npm: Please use yarn instead of NPM to install dependencies
engines.pnpm: Please use yarn instead of PNPM to install dependencies

scripts.b:all: yarn b:config && yarn b:syntax && yarn b:formatero && yarn b:lintero && yarn b:monorepo && yarn b:testero
scripts.c:all: yarn c:config && yarn c:syntax && yarn c:formatero && yarn c:lintero && yarn c:monorepo && yarn c:testero
scripts.c:config: yarn l:config && yarn t:config && yarn b:config && yarn et:config
scripts.c:formatero: yarn l:formatero && yarn t:formatero && yarn b:formatero && yarn et:formatero
scripts.c:lintero: yarn l:lintero && yarn t:lintero && yarn b:lintero && yarn et:lintero
scripts.c:monorepo: yarn l:monorepo && yarn t:monorepo && yarn b:monorepo && yarn et:monorepo
scripts.c:syntax: yarn l:syntax && yarn t:syntax && yarn b:syntax && yarn et:syntax
scripts.c:testero: yarn l:testero && yarn t:testero && yarn b:testero && yarn et:testero
scripts.ct:all: yarn ct:config && yarn ct:syntax && yarn ct:formatero && yarn ct:lintero && yarn ct:monorepo && yarn ct:testero
scripts.et:all: tsc -b shared/config shared/syntax packages/formatero packages/lintero packages/monorepo packages/testero
scripts.l:all: yarn b:formatero && yarn b:lintero && formatero && lintero
scripts.l:config: yarn b:formatero && yarn b:lintero && formatero shared/config && lintero shared/config
scripts.l:formatero: yarn b:formatero && yarn b:lintero && formatero packages/formatero && lintero packages/formatero
scripts.l:lintero: yarn b:formatero && yarn b:lintero && formatero packages/lintero && lintero packages/lintero
scripts.l:monorepo: yarn b:formatero && yarn b:lintero && formatero packages/monorepo && lintero packages/monorepo
scripts.l:syntax: yarn b:formatero && yarn b:lintero && formatero shared/syntax && lintero shared/syntax
scripts.l:testero: yarn b:formatero && yarn b:lintero && formatero packages/testero && lintero packages/testero
scripts.lw:all: yarn b:formatero && yarn b:lintero && lintero --write; formatero --write && lintero
scripts.lw:formatero: yarn b:formatero && yarn b:lintero && lintero packages/formatero --write; formatero packages/formatero --write && lintero packages/formatero
scripts.lw:lintero: yarn b:formatero && yarn b:lintero && lintero packages/lintero --write; formatero packages/lintero --write && lintero packages/lintero
scripts.lw:monorepo: yarn b:formatero && yarn b:lintero && lintero packages/monorepo --write; formatero packages/monorepo --write && lintero packages/monorepo
scripts.lw:testero: yarn b:formatero && yarn b:lintero && lintero packages/testero --write; formatero packages/testero --write && lintero packages/testero
scripts.lwu:all: yarn b:formatero && yarn b:lintero && lintero --write --unsafe; formatero --write && lintero
scripts.lwu:formatero: yarn b:formatero && yarn b:lintero && lintero packages/formatero --write --unsafe; formatero packages/formatero --write && lintero packages/formatero
scripts.lwu:lintero: yarn b:formatero && yarn b:lintero && lintero packages/lintero --write --unsafe; formatero packages/lintero --write && lintero packages/lintero
scripts.lwu:monorepo: yarn b:formatero && yarn b:lintero && lintero packages/monorepo --write --unsafe; formatero packages/monorepo --write && lintero packages/monorepo
scripts.lwu:testero: yarn b:formatero && yarn b:lintero && lintero packages/testero --write --unsafe; formatero packages/testero --write && lintero packages/testero
scripts.p:all: yarn workspaces foreach -At --no-private --topological npm publish --access public --tolerate-republish
